headline: HOW DID 20,000 PEOPLE BREATHE 85 m UNDERGROUND?
display: 20,000 people, 85 meters underground… so how did they breathe?
The answer is in these shafts.
More than 50 ventilation shafts run from the surface of Derinkuyu down to the deepest floors.
Fresh air sinks in. Stale air rises out. No machines at all.
Some shafts even reach groundwater, so they doubled as wells.
It stays 13–15 °C down there, all year round.
20,000 people… and not one of them needed a window.
